title: Senior Product Designer - Vice President
description:
About The Role

iCapital is seeking a Senior UX Designer to help shape and elevate the user experience across our fintech platform. This role requires a strong blend of UX, interaction, and visual design expertise to create intuitive, modern, and impactful digital experiences. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker and skilled problem solver who is passionate about user-centered design and cross-functional collaboration. They stay current with emerging technologies, design trends, and UX best practices, applying these insights to enhance client experiences, drive product adoption, and support business growth.

Responsibilities



- Own the full UX design process, including discovery research, information architecture, user flows, wireframing, and high-fidelity prototyping.
- Rely on qualitative and quantitative data to drive design decisions.
- Create pixel-perfect designs and prototypes leveraging iCapital’s Design System.
- Collaborate effectively with Product Managers and Engineering teams to shape, review, and iterate on product enhancements and proposals, ensuring solutions are executed with quality, consistency, and attention to user experience.
- Manage multiple concurrent requests and requirements.
- Step outside the design realm when appropriate to contribute to the team and overall company mission.
- Present work to all levels of the company with confidence.
- When necessary, lead, coach and mentor other designers on the team.

Qualifications



- Bachelor's Degree (BA or BFA) with 10+ years of demonstrated experience solving design challenges using user-centered design best practices
- Strong systems-thinking skills, with the ability to understand complex workflows, connect user needs with business objectives, and design cohesive experiences across large product ecosystems
- Demonstrated experience designing application workflows, onboarding journeys, and user guidance for digital products
- Deep expertise with Figma and modern design workflows, including design systems, prototyping, and developer handoff
- Experience leveraging AI-powered tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude, Figma AI, and similar technologies) to enhance design workflows, accelerate ideation, support research synthesis and increase team productivity

- Demonstrated ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced environment

- Experience in FinTech, WealthTech, or complex enterprise platforms is a plus

Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $140,000 to $170,000. iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package

description:

The company focuses on transforming overwhelming household management into clear, structured routines and seamless daily support. Through smart, step-by-step guidance and access to trusted domestic help, Spruced helps people reclaim their time and peace of mind. The team is reimagining how home care works by replacing rigid systems and costly services with flexible, real-time assistance tailored to each user’s lifestyle.
Role Description This is a full-time, remote, unpaid UI/UX Designer Internship role. The intern will support the design of intuitive, user-centered interfaces for Spruced’s web and mobile experiences, focusing on clarity, ease of use, and visual consistency. Day-to-day tasks include creating wireframes, interactive prototypes, and user flows; collaborating with product and engineering to translate requirements into usable designs; and refining layouts, typography, and component behavior. The intern will assist in conducting user research and usability testing, synthesizing feedback into design improvements, and documenting design decisions for team alignment. This role offers exposure to a fast-paced, mission-driven environment and the opportunity to contribute to real product features that impact everyday home management.
Qualifications
 

- Strong foundation in UI/UX design, including experience with wireframing, prototyping, and interaction design for web or mobile products.
- Proficiency with modern design tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) and ability to create clean, consistent design systems and components.
- Basic understanding of user research methods, usability testing, and translating qualitative and quantitative insights into design decisions.
- Knowledge of information architecture, user flows, and accessibility principles to ensure inclusive and intuitive experiences.
- Ability to collaborate effectively in a remote team, communicate design rationale clearly, and incorporate feedback constructively.
- Currently pursuing or recently completed studies in Design, HCI, Interaction Design, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- Portfolio demonstrating UI/UX projects, personal or academic, with examples of problem-solving, iteration, and attention to detail.
- Interest in home management, consumer apps, or AI-powered products, and motivation to learn and grow in a startup environment.

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Link team builds the global, consumer network for next-generation commerce, using our base of 300M+ registered consumers to pioneer the future of Identity, Consumer Finance, and AI-driven transactions. While our foundation was built on high-conversion merchant payments and a flexible digital wallet, we are expanding far beyond. We are building the infrastructure for a world where AI agents transact on your behalf, stablecoins go mainstream, and identity dictates how money moves.

We think of Link as the wallet for the internet — and we're building for what's next.

What you'll do

As a Staff Designer on Link, you'll lead the visual design direction for some of Link's newest and most ambitious bets. You'll define what a product looks like and feels like, bring visual conviction to early-stage concepts, and shape Link's expanding consumer presence across Stripe’s checkout, with our AI partners, and in Link’s own app. This is a role for someone who does their best work when the problem is undefined and the canvas is blank.

Responsibilities



- Define the visual design direction for net-new Link products and surfaces from the ground up across mobile and web
- Lead design exploration on early-stage, pre-roadmap opportunities from initial concept through launch
- Build new visual languages, component patterns, and design systems for products that don't exist yet
- Partner with brand designers to extend and evolve Link's visual identity into new product categories
- Shape early product strategy through design exploration and rapid prototyping, making abstract opportunities tangible for product and engineering partners
- Represent Link's design vision in senior reviews and establish the creative bar for new product areas


Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements



- 8+ years of product design experience with a strong visual and mobile design foundation
- Portfolio with clear 0-1 work and products you took from concept to launch where you defined the visual language
- Demonstrated ability to create cohesive, distinctive visual systems for new products from scratch
- Deep fluency across visual design, interaction design, and prototyping
- Experience working in high-ambiguity environments where you framed the problem

Concept and execute visually compelling, performance-driven email campaigns that support marketing strategy and brand vision across channels. At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Responsibilities

Loom Design is seeking an experienced and passionate Lead Product Designer to help us create the most human way to communicate at work with teammates of all types (agents and humans). Loom defined async video, but AI is reshaping information flow. The next era moves beyond text boxes and chat windows to high-bandwidth, multimodal communication (video, screen, voice) that compresses rich context into minutes. The video interaction model between humans and agents is yet to be designed. We're building it.

Riding the wave of change with AI, the Loom Design team tackles problems without existing patterns—how humans instruct AI via voice and screen, how agents respond visually, and how async video becomes consumable in seconds rather than minutes. As Lead Product Designer, you’ll work across the product spectrum, guiding us through AI's evolving landscape while keeping Loom a beloved tool to reduce meeting time. You’ll also help define cross-product experiences with Jira and Confluence, making Loom essential to millions of users worldwide.

We're seeking a craft and product experience focused designer who thrives in ambiguity, values user experience, and drives forward with empathy, clarity, and resilience. We want a Designer eager to ship. Loom designers contribute code, build technical prototypes, and use AI tools to shorten the gap between intent and implementation. If you can fix a visual issue in a PR, you will.

- Elevate design craft: Set a high bar for interaction, visual, and motion design. Champion design principles and ensure consistency across product surfaces.

- Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with PM, Eng, UXR to deliver delightful, high-impact features.

Designer I – Product Development (Ruskin | Grandview, MO)

Job Summary Statement

Ruskin, a subsidiary of Air Distribution Technologies, Inc., is seeking a Designer I – Product Development to support new product innovation and ongoing product enhancements at our Grandview, Missouri facility. This role is responsible for executing entry-level design projects, contributing to product development initiatives, and supporting engineering teams with CAD deliverables, product modifications, and release coordination. The Designer I will play a key role in ensuring designs meet customer expectations, manufacturing capabilities, and company standards.

What You’ll Do



- Plan and execute basic design projects related to new product development and existing product improvements
- Support redesign efforts and production modifications to enhance product performance and manufacturability
- Create and maintain CAD models, drawings, and documentation for assigned projects
- Assist with customer-facing CAD deliverables and design specifications
- Coordinate layout and packaging requirements for product designs
- Support engineering change releases and documentation processes using EPIC or similar systems
- Conduct CAD studies and analyses to evaluate design concepts and improvements
- Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, and cross-functional teams to ensure design feasibility
- Maintain accuracy and compliance with company design standards and procedures

What We’re Looking For



- Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 1 year of related experience, OR
- Associate degree with a minimum of 6 years of related experience, OR
- Equivalent combination of education and relevant design experience
- Experience with CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or similar)
- Basic understanding of product design, drafting standards, and manufacturing processes
- Ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications

Preferred



- Experience in HVAC, air movement, or manufacturing product design
- Familiarity with EPIC or engineering change management systems
- Exposure to product lifecycle management (PLM) systems
- Knowledge of sheet metal or mechanical component design

Work Environment

This position operates in a hybrid environment that includes both office and manufacturing settings. The role involves working at a computer for extended periods as well as occasional time on the production floor. Exposure to noise, moving equipment, and manufacturing processes may occur. Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) may be required when in production areas. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities.

title: Knitwear Designer
description:
Rose Holding USA is the United States arm of Rose Group, a vertically integrated sweater and knitwear manufacturer based in Bangladesh. We manage design, development, and production programs for established brands including French Connection, Karl Lagerfeld, DKNY/Nautica, Margaritaville, and Chaps.

- Present seasonal concept boards and line reviews to buyers
- Monitor competitor assortments, retail pricing, and emerging category trends

- 3+ years of dedicated sweater design experience across full-fashion and cut-and-sew
- Comprehensive knowledge of gauges (3gg–16gg), yarn types, and knit construction

- Demonstrated ability to read and correct knit-downs

Details
